query: 'SELECT YEAR(x.d)*10000 + MONTH(x.d)*100 + DAY(x.d) AS fecha_key,
       x.d AS fecha_completa,
       CAST(YEAR(x.d) AS smallint) AS anio,
       CAST(DATEPART(quarter, x.d) AS tinyint) AS trimestre,
       CONCAT('T', DATEPART(quarter, x.d)) AS trimestre_nombre,
       CAST(MONTH(x.d) AS tinyint) AS mes,
       CHOOSE(MONTH(x.d),'Enero','Febrero','Marzo','Abril','Mayo','Junio','Julio','Agosto','Septiembre','Octubre','Noviembre','Diciembre') AS mes_nombre,
       CHOOSE(MONTH(x.d),'Ene','Feb','Mar','Abr','May','Jun','Jul','Ago','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dic') AS mes_corto,
       CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, x.d) AS tinyint) AS semana_anio,
       CAST(DAY(x.d) AS tinyint) AS dia_mes,
       CAST(x.dsem AS tinyint) AS dia_semana,
       CHOOSE(x.dsem,'Lunes','Martes','Miércoles','Jueves','Viernes','Sábado','Domingo') AS dia_nombre,
       CAST(CASE WHEN x.dsem IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit) AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
  SELECT f.d, (DATEDIFF(day, '19000101', f.d) % 7) + 1 AS dsem
  FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS d FROM silver.admissions
    UNION SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions
    UNION SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing
  ) f
  WHERE f.d IS NOT NULL
) x',
